Rae (docs): quick PR to fix dashboard example for KV-prefix filters + a short note on cost attribution. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6001
Marco (eng-obsv): nice. paste the snippet?
Rae (docs): here's the YAML sample:
```yaml
dashboard: kv-cost-summary
filters:
  - field: 'kv.key_prefix'
    op: 'starts_with'
    value: 'session/'
metrics:
  - name: cost_per_token
    query: 'sum:tokens.cost by kv.key_prefix'
```
Izzy (devex): running in playground now, will attach screenshot.
Lee (sdk): FYI python still uses include_cost_breakdown, JS uses includeCost. added a cross-lang note in the PR.
Marco (eng-obsv): wording suggestion: "Prefix grouping aggregates by prefix. For per-key outliers, enable sampled per-key traces."
Rae (docs): added that line and a compat note for older exports that used kv_prefix -> show as unknown.
preview-bot: preview build OK: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/6001
Izzy (devex): screenshot looks good, small UX note: empty prefix shows all groups; documented.
Lee (sdk): opened micro PR to sync snippets in SDK repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/401
Rae (docs): thanks all, will merge after SDK PR lands and preview updates.
thread_summary: Coordination for a docs PR updating dashboard snippet to use kv.key_prefix, noting SDK param differences and compatibility.
